messages.subject: Use stat_vline along with facet_wrap
parts:
Hi,

I want to plot a verticle line at .3 quantile for each subplot. But
I'm not sure what syntax I should use. I tried the following, which
does not work. Could you let me know what the correct way is?

library(ggplot2)
tmp=do.call(
rbind
, lapply(
LETTERS[1:3]
, function(x) {
data.frame(value=rnorm(1000),label=x)
}
)
)
#not working
qplot(value, data=tmp)+stat_vline(xintercept=quantile(value,
.3))+facet_wrap(~label)


--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Use stat_vline along with facet_wrap
parts:
> I want to plot a verticle line at .3 quantile for each subplot. But
> I'm not sure what syntax I should use. I tried the following, which
> does not work. Could you let me know what the correct way is?
>
> library(ggplot2)
> tmp=do.call(
>    rbind
>    , lapply(
>        LETTERS[1:3]
>        , function(x) {
>          data.frame(value=rnorm(1000),label=x)
>        }
>        )
>    )

Use plyr to calculate the 30% quantile for each facet, and then plot:

tmp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(LETTERS[1:3], function(x) {
data.frame(value=rnorm(1000),label=x)
}))

quants <- ddply(tmp, "label", summarise, q30 = quantile(value, 0.3))

qplot(value, data=tmp) +
geom_vline(aes(xintercept = q30), data = quants) +
facet_wrap(~label)

Hadley
